content:
Our latest update for Fallout 76 arrives today, bringing the fun and excitement of Nuka-World to Appalachia as part of our “Nuka-World On Tour” update. It also marks the start of Season 11 and brings new rewards, gameplay improvements and much more to the game! Read on to see the full patch notes for today's update.

### UPDATE VERSION 1.7.2.9

Here you can find out the download size of today's patch on the respective platform:

**PC (Steam):** 16GB
**PC (Microsoft Store):** 25.1 GB
**PlayStation:** 22.9GB
**Xbox:** 25.1GB

### NUKA WORLD ON TOUR

Nuka-World On Tour has pitched the tents and rewarded the Nuka-Cade and is finally ready to welcome visitors! Visit the fairgrounds west of Reynolds Lake in Ash Heap for three brand new public events, win rewards in the Nuka-Cade, and unleash the biggest regional boss we've introduced to Fallout 76 so far: the Ultracite Titan!

#### NEW PUBLIC EVENTS

**The Wheel:** Visit Flaschi and Korki in the big tent to take part in the game show “The Wheel” where nothing is impossible! The rules are simple: press the button to spin the giant wheel in the tent, then complete the challenge selected in this way. Defend our beloved mascots against unique combinations of enemy creatures, knock over Brahmins, dodge exploding deer, and more! If you survive for five rounds, great prizes await you!

**Most Wanted:** Stroll to the Wild West town where Gunther lets it rip during his show. All he needs are a few aces like you who are really good with a gun and act as criminals. When the event begins, you relieve the city's residents of their belongings and store all illegally obtained valuables in your escape carriage. Then defend your catch against the long robotic arm of the law. If you kill the sheriff in the shootout that follows, you can ride off into the sunset with your stolen goods.

**Tunnel of Love:** This romantic ride is the perfect attraction for couples in love who want to spend quality time together in the swirl of lights and sounds of the fair. At least once everything is finished. Mr. Lovely just needs a little help making repairs and decorating the Tunnel of Love before passionate lovers can set off for a magical land. Don't worry, a trip into the depths of a mine shaft to hang heart-shaped decorations should be quick and completely safe for strong explorers like you. After all, the shaft has been abandoned for some time...

**Note:** For the first four weeks after the update is released, Nuka-World On Tour public events will be prioritized as new public events emerge and start every hour.

#### WIN PRIZES IN THE NUKA-CADE!

But that wasn't all! Grab some bottle caps and try out funfair games at the **Nuka-Cade**, which offer fun for the whole family, including all-time favorites like Bandit Meeting, Nuka Zapper Race and Hit the Red. We are also happy to present you “Bottle Blaster” that will put you to the test. When you play you will receive Nuka-Cade points that you can exchange for great prizes.

#### NEW REGIONAL BOSS: THE ULTRAZITE TITANIUM
